title: Some Silicon Valley city programs are missing
text: Santa Clara city teen programs, Los Altos city teen programs and Cupertino Leaders in Training are not listed yet. Those city sites block automated checks, so someone has to read them in a browser.

title: Some East Bay city programs are missing
text: San Leandro, Union City and Fremont youth commissions, and Pleasanton and Livermore library teen volunteers, are not listed yet.

title: Hospital teen volunteering is only partly covered
text: Kaiser, Santa Clara Valley Medical Center and Sutter Davis may have teen volunteer programs we could not confirm. Alta Bates Summit and Alameda Health System are 18 and up, so they are not listed.

title: Davis and West Sacramento seasonal jobs are missing
text: City lifeguard, camp counselor and recreation leader jobs are not listed, because the city sites block automated checks. Check the City of Davis and City of West Sacramento jobs pages yourself.

title: A few cards say Confirm first
text: These cards were not read on the program's own page, usually because the site blocked us. Check the details on the official site before you rely on them.

title: Boys and Girls Clubs are only partly covered
text: Only Oakland has a teen job card. Other clubs did not post teen details on their official pages.
